text:
marco (partnerships): Hi all — ACME SI asked for a security evidence bundle for marketplace listing. Quick alignment?
anya (security): Need SOC2 PDF, pen-test exec summary, questionnaire CSV, redacted screenshots, and a machine manifest (sha256).
jo (infra): Recommend: partner uploads to s3://partners/acme-evidence/{date}/ and we build two zips: portal_bundle.zip (full) + public_bundle.zip (redacted).
felix (acme-si): ACME can upload by Apr 4. We can also produce a PGP-signed manifest if that helps.
anya (security): Signed manifest is great — infra should verify signature on ingest. Also require allowed-models.txt in both bundles enumerating exact model ids/versions.
rachel (legal): Public bundle must include attestation.txt: single-liner "No customer PII; redaction performed by ACME and Redwood." I will DM the approved wording.
marco (partnerships): Timeline: upload Apr 4 -> Redwood scrub Apr 5 -> staging build Apr 6 -> internal QA Apr 7 -> publish window Apr 9. Go/no-go Apr 7 15:00 UTC.
jo (infra): I'll add a verification job: verify sha256, verify PGP signature if present, then emit evidence-index.csv with filename,sha256,owner,public_flag,presign_expiry. Presigned links expire 25 days.
felix (acme-si): ACME will redact partner-customer emails and full ticket links. We'll leave CVE ids and short remediation notes.
anya (security): Good. Redwood will remove internal hostnames (*.redwood.internal), ticket tokens (RDW-\d+), and any discovery logs with customer identifiers. I'll own the final scrub.
marco (partnerships): Action owners: @felix upload artifacts Apr 4; @anya run final redaction Apr 5; @jo add signature/checksum verification + presign Apr 6; @rachel provide attestation text today. I'll draft the 2-line security blurb for PR.
notifierbot: Reminder: "ACME listing go/no-go" 2026-04-07T15:00:00Z (invitees: marco, anya, jo, rachel, felix).
anya (security): One note: include export control check in questionnaire answers. If any dataset flags, we need compensating controls documented.
felix (acme-si): Roger that. We'll annotate questionnaire with export-control:Y/N and include contact for follow-up.
marco (partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll post the checklist and the shared S3 path in this thread tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
